verdict.rationale: Omnirush GUI is a desktop app for working with a coding agent, so it sits in the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents as an MCP server is a different product role. The only MCP evidence is client-side (adding MCP servers from the Library), which belongs to the MCP-client story and is not credited here. Nothing shows the app itself running as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
